project_type: EaseMyOffice CRM — TanStack Start + React 19 SPA with Supabase (Postgres + RLS + Deno edge functions) backend, hosted on Cloudflare Workers. HRMS (attendance/leave/payroll) lives inside the same app.
language: TypeScript (React 19, TSX); Deno TypeScript for edge functions
build_system: Bun. CI = tsc --noEmit + vitest + vite build. Edge functions deploy via GitHub Actions on push to main; DB migrations are APPLIED MANUALLY BY THE OWNER (never auto-run).
test_framework: Vitest unit tests in src/lib/*.test.ts (e.g. src/lib/attendance-rules.test.ts, 52 tests). Playwright e2e in e2e/ (not needed for this task).
test_command: bun run test (vitest run). Typecheck: export PATH to include node (ls /root/.nvm/versions/node for the patch version) then ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit — npx may not be on PATH. Edge fn typecheck: npx -y deno check supabase/functions/hr-requests/index.ts
verification_instructions: Run all three gates and require green: (1) ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit (export node to PATH first), (2) bun run test, (3) bun run build. Also deno check the hr-requests edge function. The byte-identical test in src/lib/attendance-rules.test.ts ('shared copy') MUST pass — if you edit either attendance-rules.ts you must edit BOTH identically.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. TanStack router generates src/routeTree.gen.ts at build; do not hand-edit. New routes are picked up automatically from src/routes/.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice && bun install --frozen-lockfile (~562 packages). export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (verify patch version via ls /root/.nvm/versions/node). Baseline must be green before any change.
environment_constraints: npm registry reachable so full pipeline runs in-sandbox. Cannot push or open PRs — the orchestrator publishes. DB migrations are NOT applied by CI/CD; the OWNER applies them manually, so any migration MUST be idempotent and the app MUST degrade gracefully if it has not been applied yet.
contribution_requirements: Strictly additive and backward-compatible. The live punch flow (attendance-punch), missed-login regularization, leave, payroll, My Attendance and the command center must keep working unchanged and must read admin-entered days IDENTICALLY to punched days. Permissions enforced SERVER-SIDE (admin check in the edge function) — never trust the client for who may write attendance. Keep pure date/compute logic in the shared rules lib with concrete-value unit tests. If you add a shared helper, mirror it byte-identically in BOTH src/lib/attendance-rules.ts and supabase/functions/_shared/attendance-rules.ts.
key_patterns: The attendance table is the single source of truth per employee per day (UNIQUE employee_id+work_date). Status CHECK (verified across all migrations) = ('in_progress','present','short','half_day') — only ever write one of these. Rows are written only by attendance-punch and by hr-requests' approved missed-login path. That path already does EXACTLY 'set a day's login/logout and recompute it correctly' via the pure helper regularizedAttendance(...) (closeDay/lateMinutes/windowMinutes). The edge function hr-requests/index.ts has a private async regularizeDay(db, {employeeId, workDate, loginMinutes, logoutMinutes}) that create-or-updates the attendance row with all derived fields, snapshotting the day's schedule from hr_settings.day_schedules via normalizeSchedules(...)[weekdayOf(work_date)] (via scheduleFor). Times are IST — reuse istInstant / minutesSinceIstMidnight / parseHHMM helpers already in that file; never use raw new Date(iso) for date-only strings. hr-requests already resolves the caller and computes isAdmin from user_roles; admin-only actions return 403 when !isAdmin. The browser calls it through hrRequest(body) in src/lib/attendance-client.ts (throws on {ok:false,message}). Audit: src/lib/audit.ts logAudit({actorId, action, entity, ...}) is fire-and-forget, inserts into audit_log; audit_log.entity_type is a free TEXT column (NO CHECK constraint) so a new entity value needs no migration, but AuditEntity is a TS union that must be extended. RLS on audit_log requires actor_id = auth.uid(), so audit is logged client-side after a successful admin write. Admin attendance UI = src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/attendance.tsx (GlassTabs: Today / Monthly / Security / Devices; MonthlyView has a per-employee Dialog showing MonthCalendar). MonthCalendar in src/components/hrms/attendance-month.tsx accepts optional onDayClick(date) that only fires for ACTIONABLE_DAY_KINDS. Admin guard is on the /hrms layout route.
relevant_files: supabase/functions/_shared/attendance-rules.ts (pure rules: regularizedAttendance, closeDay, lateMinutes, windowMinutes, normalizeSchedules, weekdayOf, timeToMinutes, istMidnightMs; KEEP byte-identical to src copy)
src/lib/attendance-rules.test.ts (52 tests incl. 'shared copy' byte-identical check and regularizedAttendance cases — add new validator/helper tests here)
supabase/functions/hr-requests/index.ts (edge function: isAdmin gate, regularizeDay, scheduleFor, istInstant, parseHHMM, minutesSinceIstMidnight — add new admin actions here)
src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/attendance.tsx (admin attendance screen — add single-day dialog + bulk back-fill entry here)
src/lib/hrms.ts (Employee, AttendanceRow types, employeeName, formatMinutes, hrmsDb)
AGENT_CONTEXT.md (conventions: owner applies migrations, short Hinglish replies, team = Kishan/Sarthak/Hardik/Neha)
directory_structure: src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/*.tsx = admin HRMS screens. src/components/hrms/* = shared HRMS components. src/lib/* = pure libs + unit tests. supabase/functions/<fn>/index.ts = Deno edge functions; supabase/functions/_shared/* = shared code. supabase/migrations/*.sql = schema (owner-applied). setup/*.sql = one-off DDL like ADD_AUDIT_LOG.sql.
